--analyzer.help: The name of the analyzer that was run.

--analyzer_names.help: Set of analyzers that we will automatically run right after the timelines are uploaded. The input needs to be the analyzers names.Provided as strings separated by space

--annotated-only.help: Export only events that have annotations (labels, stars, comments).

--archived.help: Show only archived sketches. Mutually exclusive with --archived-with-open-indexes.

--archived-with-open-indexes.help: Show archived sketches that have at least one searchindex with status 'new', 'ready', 'processing', 'fail','archived' or 'timeout'. Mutually exclusive with --archived. This will query OpenSearch.

--attributes.help: Attributes of the event. Example: key1=value1,key2=value2

--bucket.help: Google Cloud Storage bucket to monitor

--columns.help: Comma separated list of columns to show. (default: ioc,type)

--comment.help: Comment to add to the event.

--compare.help: Compare results with standard inverted index search.

--config_file.help: Path to the file containing the config data to feed sigma

--config_section.help: The config section in the RC file that will be used to define server information.

--context.help: Set a context for the file upload. This could be a text describing how the data got collected or parameters to the tool. Defaults to how the CLI tool got run.

--count.help: Number of dummy events to generate.

--data_label.help: The data label is used by the API to determine whether a new search index needs to be created or if the data can be appended to an already existing index. If a file is added this defaults to the file extension, otherwise a default value of generic is applied.

--default-fields.help: Export only the default set of event fields. If not specified, all fields are exported.

--describe.help: Show the query and filter then exit

--end-date.help: End date/time for event generation (ISO 8601). E.g., '2023-10-27T18:30:00+00:00'. Assumed UTC if no timezone specified.

--export_csv.help: Export the results to a CSV file.

--filename.help: Filename to export annotated events to.

--force.help: Force delete even if group is used in sketches.

--force_delete.help: Only execute the deletion if this is set.

--format_string.help: Formatting string for the message field. If there is no message field in the input data a message string can be composed using a format string.

--header/--no-header.help: Include header in output. (default is to show header))

--hostname.help: The URI to the Timesketch instance

--include-deleted.help: Include deleted sketches. Default: deleted sketches are hidden.

--include-legacy.help: Include legacy events (missing __ts_timeline_id). Use with caution as it may cause data leakage in shared-index environments.

--index-name.help: If the data should be imported into a specific timeline the index name needs to be provided, otherwise a new index will be generated.

--index_name.help: Searchindex name to search for e.g. 4c5afdf60c6e49499801368b7f238353.

--ioc-type.help: Type of the intelligence (ipv4, hash_sha256, hash_sha1, hash_md5, other).

--kill.help: Attempt to find and revoke (kill) the active or queued Celery task for this analysis.

--limit.help: Limit amount of events to show (default: 40)

--log-config-file.help: Path to a YAML config file that defines the config for parsing and setting up file parsing. By default formatter.yaml that comes with the importer will be used.

--max-payload-size.help: The maximum size in bytes for a single HTTP upload request. This should match the server's MAX_FORM_MEMORY_SIZE. Defaults to 200MB.

--move.help: Path to the file containing the config data to feed sigma

--no-wait.help: By default the tool will wait until the timeline has been indexed and print out some details of the import. This option makes the tool exit as soon as the data has been imported and does not wait until it's been indexed.

--order.help: Order the output (asc/desc) based on the time field

--output.help: Path to the output CSV file.

--output-format.help: Set output format [json, text, tabular, csv] (overrides global setting).

--query.help: Search query in raw wildcard format (e.g. *evil* or message:*evil*)

--saved-search.help: Query and filter from saved search

--searchindex-id.help: Optional: The OpenSearch index name for the event.

--searchindex_id.help: Searchindex database ID to search for e.g. 1.
